I added `--org` to `clever addon providers`, but I couldn't run `npm run docs` or `npm run validate` here. Dependencies aren't installed, so `docs` failed with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and `validate` stopped at `eslint: command not found`. Nothing has been linted, type-checked or tested, and I haven't run the command itself.

The change is in `src/commands/addon/addon.providers.command.js`. It adds `org: orgaIdOrNameOption`, the same option `addon list` uses, and resolves it with `Organisation.getId`. The resulting ID is passed to `Addon.listProviders(ownerId)`, which already accepted an org ID.

Because `docs` didn't run, `addon.docs.md` and the generated documentation still don't list the new option. After running `npm install`, run `npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate`, and commit the regenerated docs with the change.
